blocks.subject: Update on your basement water damage claim, 00002566
blocks.body:
Dear Chinedu,

I'm writing with an update on your claim for the burst supply line in your finished basement at 2620 Central Park Ave.

Here is where things stand:

The drying is complete, and the latest moisture readings are back to normal.

We have received the mitigation invoice from Lakeshore Restoration and the rebuild estimate from Northshore Renovation. We are reviewing both now and expect to finish this week.

Your homeowners policy covers this loss as sudden and accidental water discharge. Your $2,500 deductible applies.

The $5,000 advance we paid on September 28 for emergency drying and immediate needs will be counted toward your final settlement.

Once the estimate is approved, we will confirm the next payment and the timing for repairs to the flooring, drywall, furnace and your belongings. In the meantime, please call or email me if you have any questions.

Kind regards,

Demo User
Antsurance
